properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] AI Speech Service: No Public Access
properties.description: Denies deployment of Azure AI Speech Service (Cognitive Services) accounts with public network access enabled. FedRAMP High requires boundary protection (SC-7). Speech services processing federal audio data — including PII in speech content — must only be accessible via Private Endpoint to prevent unauthorized interception of audio streams and transcription data.

metadata.description: Deny: Block Speech Service accounts with public access. Audit: Report non-compliance only. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
